WITH media_obs AS (
    SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_media_obstetrica
    FROM internacoes i
    WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2
)
SELECT mu."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS nome,
       mu."SG_UF" AS estado,
       COUNT(*) AS total_obstetrico,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS taxa_mort_obstetrica,
       ROUND(mo.taxa_media_obstetrica, 4) AS media_nacional
FROM internacoes i
JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D", media_obs mo
WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2
GROUP BY mu."NO_MUNICIPIO", mu."SG_UF", mo.taxa_media_obstetrica
HAVING COUNT(*) > 200
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > mo.taxa_media_obstetrica
ORDER BY taxa_mort_obstetrica DESC
LIMIT 10;

         CASE WHEN i.IDADE < 18 THEN '<18' WHEN i.IDADE < 60 THEN '18-59'
              ELSE '60+' END AS faixa_etaria,
         p.NOME_PROC AS procedimento, COUNT(*) AS total,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DESCRICAO,
           CASE WHEN i.IDADE < 18 THEN '<18' WHEN i.IDADE < 60 THEN '18-59'
                ELSE '60+' END ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) rn
  FROM internacoes i
  JOIN sexo s ON i.SEXO = s.SEXO
  JOIN procedimentos p ON i.PROC_REA = p.PROC_REA
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY sexo, faixa_etaria, total DESC;

SELECT e."DESCRICAO" AS especialidade,
       CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 'obito' ELSE 'sem_obito' END AS desfecho,
       COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes,
       ROUND(AVG(i."VAL_TOT" / NULLIF(date_diff('day', i."DT_INTER", i."DT_SAIDA") + 1, 0)), 2) AS custo_medio_por_dia_calendario
FROM internacoes i
JOIN especialidade e ON i."ESPEC" = e."ESPEC"
WHERE i."VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL
  AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL
  AND i."DT_SAIDA" IS NOT NULL
  AND date_diff('day', i."DT_INTER", i."DT_SAIDA") >= 0
GROUP BY e."DESCRICAO", desfecho
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000
ORDER BY custo_medio_por_dia_calendario DESC;

SELECT year(DT_SAIDA) AS ano,
       CASE WHEN MORTE THEN 'obito' ELSE 'sem_obito' END AS desfecho,
       COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE DIAG_SECUN <> '0') AS com_diag_secundario,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE DIAG_SECUN <> '0') / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentual
FROM internacoes
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

gt_gt234.sql: WITH limite AS (SELECT QUANTILE_CONT("VAL_TOT", 0.99) AS p99_valor FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL), alto_custo AS (SELECT i."DIAG_PRINC", i."VAL_TOT" FROM internacoes i, limite l WHERE i."VAL_TOT" > l.p99_valor) SELECT c."DS_CAPITULO" AS capitulo_cid, COUNT(*) AS internacoes_alto_custo, ROUND(SUM(a."VAL_TOT"), 2) AS custo_total_alto_custo FROM alto_custo a LEFT JOIN cid c ON a."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" GROUP BY c."DS_CAPITULO" ORDER BY internacoes_alto_custo DESC;
